post.originalText:
this insane rendering of the swamp experience is happening on a browser usign threejs

this was vibe coded entirely in opus 5.5 - no one shot prompt - lot of steering..

this is vastly improved from the last version of the moonlit swamp that went viral and was featured by openai on threads and tiktok..

ll post another one soemtime this week with all the details.. - there is just an insane amount of details here..

the water wake, the lighting etc..

there is even a crane that glides over the water.. just a peaceful swamp is all.. i asked.

backstory - i was trying to get the swamp experience of gta 6 - and then i saw it din look that great with buildings - and just turned into a quieter swamp
